title: 2D Offset Pass starts at: Arc in the plane is the default entry; a user-selected Helix, Ramp or Plunge gives a warning; remove the automatic #3577 ramp

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

body:
Part of #3741. Builds on #3746 (the air entry) and #3747 (the in-plane links).

## The maintainer's words

"you would never helix on a outside cut.. as you dont need to "lead in" like that.. so an outside cut would default to a ARC or straight approach in the plane of its cut, starting outside the stock boundary with a given value."

From the #3741 comment: "An Outside cut never uses a helix entry, and it does not use a ramp entry." Pin: "an Outside pass has no helix move and no ramp move into material, and that each entry starts outside the stock boundary."

## What happens

A start-side pass can still enter by a helix or a ramp at four places:

1. The first entry of a level: `descent.rs:216-286` (`plan_arm`) with the user's Helix or Ramp; `descent.rs:131-136` (a helix stands down to a ramp).
2. The #3577 dead-end ramp: `level_ramp_entry.rs:100-127` (`dead_end_ramp`), marks at `level_order.rs:143-145`, plan check at `level_rings.rs:108`, call at `ladder_links.rs:188-191`. Decision: `docs/decisions/3567-ramp-entry-at-dead-end.md`.
3. The #2265 solid restart between passes: `ladder_links.rs:200-211`.
4. The centre-cutting law stand-ins: `descent.rs:137-148`.

Readings (synthetic dog-bone part; see the #3741 research comment): Outside on `main` has 366 ramp moves (13 dead-end ramps). On `47aa341ff^1` the same 13 re-entries were plunges or helices.

## Fix approach

1. After #3746 and #3747 a start-side pass has one entry for each level (the air entry) and no re-entry into uncut stock. The dead ends of #3567 do not exist with the contour-parallel rings of #3744.
2. Remove `dead_end_ramp`, its marks (`ramp_starts`) and its plan check. Update `docs/decisions/3567-ramp-entry-at-dead-end.md` with a "superseded by #3741" line.
3. On a start-side pass, a restart that would need a helix or a ramp lifts and uses the air entry, or the op is refused with a named reason. It never helixes or ramps into stock.
4. Rewrite the pins of `crates/motion/tests/pass_start_engagement.rs` that assert a ramp ran. The late-entry pin counts every entry into stock again (no ramp exemption).

## Pins (red first)

- `start_side_pass_has_no_helix_or_ramp`: Inside and Outside on the dog-bone part and on `testdata/models/fig8.step` have no helix move and no ramp move below the material top.
- `start_side_entries_start_outside_the_box`: each entry of a start-side pass starts outside the stock box by at least the tool radius plus the approach distance.
- `outside_entries_after_the_first_land_in_cleared_stock` (existing, `pass_start_engagement.rs:181`) stays green with no ramp exemption.

Effort `high`: removal of one entry law and its pins, under the safety floor.

Done means: the pins are green, `dead_end_ramp` is gone, and the #3567 decision file names #3741.
